title: Pink and Leaf Green Dye
summary: Single-use dye recolours compatible equipment pink and leaf green.

fields.Apply: Combine with compatible clothing or equipment. A new dye replaces the prior dye. Dye Remover restores original colours.
fields.Acquisition: Possible random merchant stock from party level 5.
fields.Base value: 6 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
